messages:
maya: Heads-up — procurement emailed a manifest change. 48 H100s shifted ~1 week. ETA window now around 2024-05-20 to 2024-05-22. Notified staging team and wanted to check downstream impacts.
ashok: Oof. Which sites and racks? we planned 8/node per rack for the first wave.
kevin: Procurement note says split SFO/IAD. Pasting snippet from their email:
```
manifest:
  SFO: 26 H100s -> ship week 05/20
  IAD: 22 H100s -> ship week 05/22
  notes: some trays delayed due to vendor QA
```
lina: Power vendor last update was PDUs by 2024-05-15. if that's still true we can stage as racks arrive, otherwise we'll have a gap for power/cabling.
infra-bot: pod-checker: Rack U12-U20 flagged: missing PDUs (3). open ticket INF-3420. :warning:
sophia: If PDUs slip we should shift the canary by one week. @kevin can you update the canary runbook and create the CR so SRE/storage are looped in?
kevin: On it. Created CR-7891 to move canary to the week after arrival and adjust node target counts. tagging reviewers @lina @ashok.
lina: Reviewing CR-7891 now. quick note — vendor replied: PDUs on backorder, new ETA 2024-05-18. Less bad than full slip but still tight.
maya: Ok action list (short):
  1) kevin: CR + runbook update (tracking CR-7891) ✅
  2) ashok: confirm rack assignments + cable kits by EOD
  3) lina: confirm PDU ETA to procurement & ops and update INF-3420
  4) sophia: update canary schedule & notify SRE once CR lands
  5) procurement: reconcile manifest and confirm shipping windows
Anything else to add?
ashok: I'll confirm rack mapping and cable kit counts. small caveat — we need 20x 1U ethernet splitters for management NICs (forgot to order). Ordering now, ETA 3 days.
kevin: For the runbook, changing the canary window is just this YAML fragment — anyone object?
```
canary:
  start: 2024-05-29T03:00:00Z
  duration: 72h
  nodes: 12
```
sophia: fwiw proposal: fallback plan if PDUs delayed >1 week — use 6 nodes from reserved dedicated pool (temporary) to keep SLAs. will cost a bit but avoids customer impact.
maya: Agree keep fallback as option. good to have cost numbers but prioritize delivery.
ashok: pinging vendor slack and procurement channel for manifest reconciliation @procurement — please confirm the SFO/IAD split and any serial numbers.
procurement: Confirmed received. reconciling with vendor now, will update manifest and follow up in this thread once we have shipment tracking numbers.
deploy-bot: canary-run scheduled (tentative) -> 2024-05-29 03:00Z (pending CR-7891 + PDUs)
kevin: Thanks — I'll hold on final run until PDUs confirmed. will update CR and add checklist items for cable kits + PDUs.
maya: Let's reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for a quick sync. If anything changes before then, drop notes here. :calendar:
ashok: ack.
lina: ack. I'll post INF-3420 updates here.
sophia: ack. I'll draft the SRE notification once CR is merged. :thumbsup:
